topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: The rain hits the pavement in heavy beats, same as the rhythm of my heart. I step out, the city lights blurred by the downpour, and I'm scanning the street like a hawk. No car on the driveway. Just a chalk outline of where it belonged. I can taste the smoke from the last cigarette on the back of my tongue. Calls made, questions hanging thick. What are they playing at, hauling my ride without a trace? Nothing's left but the echo of my heels on the wet sidewalk and a city that swallows everything down. One word keeps bouncing around in my head, but I push it back. I got to focus. This game's got more layers than a cheap mystery novel. And I know, I ain't just gonna sit and flip pages.
